description:
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it.
When Morgue Toad dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Morgue Toad from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it.
When Morgue Toad dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Morgue Toad from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat
